title: chore: rotate Mistral API key
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Replaces the exposed `MISTRAL_API_KEY` in encrypted dev, staging, and production SOPS files.
- Keeps the previous provider key active until the replacement is deployed and verified.
- Contains no model, pricing, or runtime code changes.

Verification:
- Replacement key successfully processed a live OCR 4 image request.
- All three encrypted files decrypt to the verified replacement value.

gist.headline: Fresh keys for the hive
gist.blurb: The Mistral provider key got a careful seasonal transplant across dev, staging, and production. The new key has already read an OCR image without complaint.
gist.summary: Rotated the Mistral API key in the encrypted dev, staging, and production SOPS secret files, with the replacement verified against a live OCR 4 image request.
gist.impact: Mistral-backed OCR continues on a verified replacement credential across all deployment environments.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a careful gardener replacing a glowing key-shaped seed in three labeled pots for dev, staging, and production, while a cozy CRT terminal displays a tiny OCR image checkmark. The scene represents credential rotation and verified continuity without exposing any secret material.
